description: Use this when a traveler's flight was cancelled, delayed, overbooked or downgraded and they ask what they are owed or their options: compensation, a refund or care. EU261/UK261 check: verdict with the rule, amount, what the airline owes now, facts that would change it, where the traveler claims (airline, then national enforcement body), evidence. Flights only, not ferries. Dated official sources; stores nothing about the traveler and submits nothing. Not legal advice.

arrival_delay_minutes.description: At the final destination; if rerouted, on the new flight

carrier.description: Operating airline: IATA code or name

distance_km.description: Only if an airport is not recognised

event.description: cancelled: by the airline; denied_boarding: refused against their will, e.g. overbooking

from.description: IATA airport where the booking starts

notice_days.description: cancelled: whole days' notice before departure

reroute_departure_offset_minutes.description: cancelled: new minus original departure (negative: earlier)

name: check_flight_compensation
title: Flight compensation check (EU261/UK261)
